passage.label: excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him when they said to their people we are disassociated from you and whatever you worship other than Allah, we have denied you and animosity and hatred appeared forever until you believe in Allah alone; except Abraham's saying to his father I will surely ask forgiveness for you but I have no power for you against Allah; Our Lord upon You we relied to You we returned and to You is the destination; Our Lord make us not objects of torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, You are Exalted in Might Wise; excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day, whoever turns away Allah Free of need Praiseworthy; perhaps Allah will put affection between you and those you were enemies with, Allah competent Forgiving Merciful

arabicExcerpts.text: قَدۡ كَانَتۡ لَكُمۡ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةٞ فِيٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِذۡ قَالُواْ لِقَوۡمِهِمۡ إِنَّا بُرَءَـٰٓؤُاْ مِنكُمۡ وَمِمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَفَرۡنَا بِكُمۡ وَبَدَا بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمُ ٱلۡعَدَٰوَةُ وَٱلۡبَغۡضَآءُ أَبَدًا حَتَّىٰ تُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَحۡدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَوۡلَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسۡتَغۡفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَآ أَمۡلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَيۡءٖۖ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيۡكَ تَوَكَّلۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ أَنَبۡنَا وَإِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا رَبَّنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
لَقَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ فِيهِمۡ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةٞ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
۞عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلَّذِينَ عَادَيۡتُم مِّنۡهُم مَّوَدَّةٗۚ وَٱللَّهُ قَدِيرٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ

mainSubject.label: The excellent pattern set in Abraham and his companions declaring disassociation from their people and their worship, denying them and announcing lasting animosity until they believe in Allah alone; the single exception of Abraham's promise to seek forgiveness for his father while admitting he holds no power against Allah; their declaration of reliance, return and final destination; the taught supplication asking not to be made objects of torment for disbelievers and for forgiveness under might and wisdom; the pattern reaffirmed for whoever hopes in Allah and the Last Day, with divine independence and praiseworthiness against whoever turns away; the possibility opened that Allah may place affection between former enemies, under competence, forgiveness and mercy

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the kinship-futility and Resurrection-judgement statement (3) before the Abrahamic pattern opens (4); P2 ends with the possible-affection concession (7) before the two-category justice rule begins (8); P3 covers the permitted and forbidden categories of non-believers (8-9); P4 runs from the examination of emigrant women through compensation rulings, the women's pledge and the closing alliance prohibition (10-13).
